variants.headline: Assembly votes the government out
variants.body: The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Confidence withdrawn
variants.body: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Office meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.
